# Synplix Infotech

> Synplix Infotech is a technology company helping businesses in India adopt AI and modern technology solutions to improve their digital presence, automate work, and build better business processes.

## About

Synplix Infotech helps Indian businesses adopt AI and modern technology to improve their digital presence, automate work and build better processes without making technology complicated. Based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Remote-first, serving clients across India, the US and UK.

## Services

- **Custom Web Applications**: Full-stack web products built for speed, scale and long-term maintainability.
- **SaaS Development**: Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with billing, auth, analytics and admin tooling.
- **Business Automation**: Workflows and integrations that cut manual work across internal systems.
- **Content Systems**: Structured content and growth-ready pages for marketing and product teams.

### Solution Areas

- Web Development
- AI Solutions
- Business Automation
- SEO & Digital Growth
- WhatsApp & Communication Automation

## How We Work

Six-phase delivery model: Discovery & Strategy, Design & Prototyping, Development, Testing & QA, Launch & Deployment, Support & Growth.

### Timelines

- Marketing website: 2-4 weeks
- MVP web app: 6-8 weeks
- Full SaaS platform: 10-16 weeks
- Proposal turnaround: 48 hours

## Showcase

- **Synplix SaaS** (Beta): Multi-workspace management platform with billing and analytics.
- **Applix Wear**: E-commerce apparel store for a direct-to-consumer fashion brand.
- **CASE**: Student portfolio showcase platform - Code, Access, Share, Everywhere.
- **The Black Sheep Bistro**: Restaurant website with menu, reservations, and reviews (Goa).
- **RMDIOT**: Educational institution website for a polytechnic institute (5 departments, 50+ recruiters).
- **Amora Cafe**: Cafe website with digital menu, online ordering, and table reservations (PCMC, Pune).

## Pricing

### Website Development (one-time)
- **Starter**: Rs.4,999 (up to 5 pages) - Get your business online.
- **Business**: Rs.9,999 (up to 10 pages) - Turn your website into a growth tool. Most popular.
- **Professional**: Rs.14,999 (up to 20 pages) - Build a more powerful digital presence.

### Content Creation (monthly)
- **Basic**: Rs.5,000/month
- **Pro**: Rs.12,000/month (most popular)
- **Agency**: Rs.25,000/month

Payment terms: 50% upfront, 50% before final deployment. Free 30-minute strategy call included. Written proposal within 48 hours.

## FAQ

- Projects typically take 2-4 weeks (marketing site), 6-8 weeks (MVP), or 10-16 weeks (full SaaS).
- Start by booking a free 30-minute strategy call. Written proposal within 48 hours.
- 50% deposit required, balance on completion. Prices in INR unless specified.
- Upon full payment, all custom code, designs and assets transfer to the client.
- We work with clients globally, including US and UK alongside India.
